description: This source file provides utility functions for a notes application, including a debounce function for rate-limiting calls and a filterNotes function for filtering notes based on a search term.

methods.name: debounce(fn, wait = 250)
methods.description: Debounces a function call by a specified wait time, defaulting to 250 milliseconds.

methods.name: filterNotes(notes, term)
methods.description: Filters an array of notes to include only those where the title or content contains the search term (case-insensitive).
